title: LoopQ: Quantization for Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.16343v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase effective computational depth by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks without increasing the parameter count. However, this reuse makes them particularly sensitive to post-training quantization (PTQ). We systematically study PTQ in LoopLMs and identify three sources of degradation: distribution shift across roles, state reuse across loop transitions, and recursive error accumulation. We propose LoopQ, a loop-aware PTQ framework that preserves a shared quantized backbone while introducing lightweight adaptations. LoopQ combines loop-aware activation scaling and selective transformations to accommodate changing hidden-state distributions, cross-loop state alignment to stabilize transitions, and trajectory-aware calibration to limit accumulated error. translated_title: LoopQ：循环语言模型的量化方法
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）通过反复应用共享的Transformer块来增加有效计算深度，而无需增加参数数量。然而，这种参数重用使得它们对训练后量化（PTQ）特别敏感。我们系统地研究了LoopLMs中的PTQ问题，并识别出三个导致性能退化的来源：跨角色的分布偏移、跨循环转换的状态重用以及递归误差累积。我们提出了LoopQ，一个循环感知的PTQ框架，它在保留共享量化主干的同时引入轻量级适配。LoopQ结合了循环感知的激活缩放和选择性变换以适应不断变化的隐状态分布、跨循环状态对齐以稳定转换过程，以及轨迹感知校准以限制累积误差。在W4A4量化设置下，LoopQ在四个主干模型上实现了五任务平均准确率67.8%的平均相对提升。
tldr: LoopQ是一个针对循环语言模型的循环感知训练后量化框架，通过循环感知激活缩放、跨循环状态对齐和轨迹感知校准三种技术解决量化退化问题，在W4A4量化下将五任务平均准确率相对提升67.8%。
en_tdlr: LoopQ is a loop-aware post-training quantization framework for looped language models that combines loop-aware activation scaling, cross-loop state alignment, and trajectory-aware calibration to achieve a 67.8% average relative accuracy improvement under W4A4 quantization.
